title: Alert to runbook routing table (aiops.routing/v1)
description: Ordered match rules the normalizer uses to turn a producer message into (host, service, check, runbook_id). First match per source wins; each source ends in a catch-all so every critical alert resolves to a runbook_id (enforced by lint.py).

severity.description: The Hermod tag this route applies to. `any` matches critical and alert (not untagged).

match.description: Regex (Python re.search, case-insensitive) applied to: zabbix -> trigger name; s4-prober -> one finding line (or the message title for prober-errored); patroni/semaphore/frigg/unknown -> message title. A named group `host` overrides `host`.

check.description: Literal slug, or a template: {group} expands a named regex group, @slug expands to the slug of the matched subject (used by catch-alls).

status.description: Set for one-shot notifications with no recovery counterpart.
